title: settings (server to Polis)
description: The station's name, room and share as the server holds them, and what it may choose from: after `welcome` and whenever any of it changes, never twice the same in a row - except with `error`, which answers a request that was turned down and carries what still holds.

room.description: A room of the tournament, empty for none, or free text from before the tournament had rooms (which restricts nothing).
